prose:
Isometric SF presents a pixel-art map of the San Francisco Bay Area. The accessible page mainly supplies loading text and credits, identifying map, imagery, land-cover and elevation sources rather than explaining the implementation.

Its tile artwork is offered for noncommercial reuse with attribution under CC BY-NC 4.0; the credited underlying datasets have their own terms. The extracted page alone does not establish how well the interactive map works.
highlights: Bay Area is rendered in pixel art
Justin Chavez is credited for tiles
